text:
anya: Quick heads-up — we just cut community-templates v0.9.0. Includes new plugin templates, CI matrix, and locale helpers. Release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-templates/releases/tag/v0.9.0

lia (maintainer): Huge thanks to @suresh and @matt for the CI fixes and migration script. Highlights: faststart template, GitHub Actions matrix for py/ts, and a light-weight docker build.

matt: FYI the release script is `./scripts/release.sh v0.9.0` — run locally to create a tag, CI will auto-publish artifacts.

suresh: Added i18n README and initial Spanish translations under /i18n/es. @l10n-team can you review phrasing and date formats?

dev-bot: release-bot: community-templates v0.9.0 published -> npm: https://npmjs.com/package/@redwood/community-templates | PyPI tag in release notes.

oliver: Planning a short maintainer office hours this Friday 14:00 PT to go over upgrade steps and answer questions — sign up: https://cal.com/redwood-templates/office-hours

anya: For community contributors we added a `good first issue` label and a CONTRIBUTING.md with a tiny tutorial. Please RT to your networks :megaphone: 

lia (maintainer): Maintainer checklist I posted in the repo: 1) confirm package.json / pyproject.version bump 2) approve any backport PRs 3) run smoke tests in a Dedicated env. I'll link the checklist in a comment on the release PR.

matt: Heads-up: there is a minor breaking change in env var names used by the template generator — migration tool available: `npx ct-migrate` and migration notes at docs/migration.md

anya: If anyone hits publish or packaging errors ping me or @devops, I'll help triage. Huge congrats to everyone who shipped this :tada:

suresh: LGTM, congrats team 🎉

oliver: I'll schedule a short community demo + tweet thread for next week and add a sample screenshot for the README.
